# Phase One — Limitless UI Universe

The Awtsmoos is beyond interface and user flow; Awtsmoos.com can nevertheless reveal one coherent digital world where every route feels related without one route leaking style into another.

## Ideal experience

- Every page opens in a calm primary state with only the actions needed now.
- Advanced controls live inside native or accessible disclosures, side sheets, command palettes, inspector drawers, contextual rails, or expandable cards.
- The same conceptual patterns repeat across routes: command/search, identity, status, primary action, contextual details, advanced expansion.
- Mobile is the foundation rather than a compressed desktop afterthought.
- Every route defines its own local color/accent variables beneath an explicit body route selector.
- Shared visual contracts are opt-in utilities whose selectors always require a route root or dedicated component root.
- All panels use `min-inline-size: 0`, bounded media, safe wrapping, and explicit scroll ownership.
- Sticky/fixed navigation is sparse, safe-area aware, and never hides page content.
- Layering uses semantic local tokens such as content, sticky, overlay, sheet, toast, and modal rather than arbitrary numbers.
- Motion communicates state: hover lift, press compression, disclosure expansion, loading shimmer, focus illumination, route transitions, and success/error feedback.
- Motion automatically collapses under reduced-motion preferences.
- Dense creation tools expose a simple primary canvas first; secondary inspectors retract.
- Data-heavy admin pages expose summary cards first, filters second, raw payload/advanced controls only on demand.
- Docs show five-line quick starts before schemas and failure contracts.
- Social pages foreground conversation/content and retract governance/debug metadata.
- Drive/editor pages foreground the selected file/document and collapse secondary navigation on narrow screens.
- Auth pages remain exceptionally simple and distraction-free.
- Every page can survive 320px viewport width without accidental horizontal page scrolling.
- Every interactive element has discoverable keyboard focus and a pressed/active response.
- Any intentional horizontally scrollable region advertises that behavior visually and keeps the document itself fixed.

## JavaScript/API universe

- Route boot files become small assemblies that compose domain classes instead of owning logic.
- DOM reads/writes live in views; business state lives in models/policies; network access lives in gateways; orchestration lives in coordinators.
- Public APIs accept small serializable option objects and return stable result records.
- Existing low-level APIs remain available through adapters while ergonomic facades become easier.
- Event names and DOM selectors become data registries rather than repeated string literals.
- AbortSignal, timeout, retry, loading, empty, failure, and optimistic states are explicit.
- Complex route state can serialize enough information to reproduce bugs.
- Tests verify public contracts and DOM integration separately.

## Documentation universe

- Each route family has a compact README: purpose, entry point, style root, JS assembly, API boundaries, tests, known extensions.
- Architecture docs explain why modules exist and which direction dependencies flow.
- UI docs define the route's body/root contract and layering/overflow ownership.
- Advanced implementation details stay below quick-start guidance.
